ValidationRule.description: When marking a Mandatory Report with a terminal outcome (Closed, Substantiated, Unsubstantiated, Screened Out), Outcome_Notes is required for audit defensibility. Reports must have a written reason for their disposition.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Outcome_Status__c, "Closed"), ISPICKVAL(Outcome_Status__c, "Substantiated"), ISPICKVAL(Outcome_Status__c, "Unsubstantiated"), ISPICKVAL(Outcome_Status__c, "Screened Out") ), ISBLANK(Outcome_Notes__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: To close out a Mandatory Report (Closed / Substantiated / Unsubstantiated / Screened Out), you must add Outcome Notes describing what happened with the agency.
